title: Trainee Office Coordinator
description:
Company Description

About FRP

At FRP, we are a leading national business advisory firm based in the UK. With over 950 team members, including 100 partners, we specialise in Corporate Finance, Debt Advisory, Forensic Services, Financial Advisory, Restructuring Advisory, and Real Estate Advisory. Operating from 35 offices across the UK, Isle of Man and Cyprus, we are dedicated to helping clients navigate complex and difficult situations to create, preserve, and recover value.

Our approach is known for being honest, clear, and considered. We provide strategic solutions that cater to a broad range of businesses, from multinational organisations to small enterprises. Our commitment is to deliver expert advice and support, ensuring our clients can make informed decisions and achieve their goals.

Job Description

Role overview

We are seeking a TraineeOffice Coordinator to deliver high-quality administrative support across our Newcastle office, encompassing front of house, office administration, and local events management. This pivotal role is responsible for ensuring the smooth day-to-day running of the office, creating a professional and welcoming environment for visitors and employees, and supporting the successful delivery of local events. The successful candidate will play a key part in maintaining efficient administrative processes, enabling business functions to operate effectively, and contributing to the overall success of the firm.

Please note: FRP will be relocating its Newcastle office in the coming months. As part of this transition, the successful candidate will be required to work from our new office at One Trinity Gardens, Broad Chare, Newcastle upon Tyne, NE1 2 HF.

Key Responsibilities
- Handle telephone calls and enquiries efficiently, courteously, and professionally
- Receive clients, visitors, and suppliers; notify relevant staff members for deliveries
- Ensure the front of house and meeting rooms are clean and presentable at all times
- Assist with administrative duties for office matters including processing invoices, maintain accurate records within business systems and assisting to implement with building and safety requirements
- Assist with general administrative duties for the partners and wider team
- Coordinate and Organise local Marketing and Events including preparing and monitoring invites.
- Maintain electronic filing systems, ensuring data accuracy and supporting data cleansing initiatives as required
- Research and book venues; maintain relationships with suppliers
- Coordinate and monitor e-brief communications and other internal communications activities.
- Support client onboarding activities, including referrals, conflict checks and CRM maintenance.
- Book Partner/Director client team lunches, presentations, and local networking events
- Assist with administrative duties for events (e.g., badges, place settings, documents/presentation packs)
- Coordinate internal local networking across the business

Further Development

FRP is committed to supporting your professional development through ongoing training and learning opportunities. This may include a relevant apprenticeship or recognised qualification to help you develop your skills and progress in your role.

Qualifications
- Minimum five grade A to C GCSEs including English and Mathematics
- Previous experience in business administration and front-of-house/customer-facing roles is advantageous.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Highly organised and meticulous, with excellent attention to detail.
- Excellent time management and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.

Additional Information

Our Values
- Straightforward: We provide clear, no-nonsense advice
- Confident: Our guidance is backed by expertise and evidence
- Pragmatic: We focus on practical solutions and tangible outcomes
- Real: We are professional yet approachable, understanding the challenges our clients face

Our Commitment to You and the Environment

At FRP, sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on building and maintaining meaningful, long-term relationships with all our stakeholders - including our employees, clients, and local communities - while also reducing our impact on the natural environment.

We are always striving to improve in all areas - whether it's our people, our clients, our planet or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and diverse culture for our people. We maintain an Equal Opportunities Policy, ensuring that recruitment and employment decisions are based solely on the skills and experience required for our professional services - regardless of ethnicity, race, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe every individual should have the opportunity to thrive.

Our learning and development programmes enable us to invest in growing our employees' careers. We aim to empower our team members to each achieve their potential.

We are committed to growing long-term relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We are emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

title: Finance Coordinator
description:
The OpportunityNorth Tyneside £25,587 - £27,251 Permanent 28-35 Hours per Week

Nigel Wright is delighted to be supporting a well-established and values-led organisation in the North Tyneside area with the recruitment of a Finance Coordinator.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced finance professional to join a friendly and collaborative finance team, playing a key role in day-to-day income processing, customer account management, payroll support and financial administration. The position will also be heavily involved in the implementation of a new finance system, offering exposure to systems change and process improvement projects.

Key ResponsibilitiesReporting to the Finance Manager, responsibilities will include:
- Managing customer accounts and responding to finance-related queries.
- Raising invoices and supporting regular billing cycles.
- Processing and reconciling a variety of income streams.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting financial controls.
- Assisting with payroll administration and reconciliations.
- Supporting month-end activities, account reconciliations and reporting.
- Handling banking activities, cash processing and associated administration.
- Working closely with operational managers to reconcile schedules and resolve discrepancies.
- Supporting the implementation and ongoing development of a new finance system.
- Contributing to continuous improvement of finance processes and controls.

What we're looking for We are keen to speak with candidates who have:
- Previous experience working within a finance or accounts function.
- Experience of sales ledger, invoicing, reconciliations and income processing.
- Strong Excel skills, including the ability to manipulate and analyse data.
- Experience using finance systems such as Sage, SAP, Oracle, Xero, Microsoft Dynamics or similar.
- Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills.
- A proactive approach with the confidence to investigate and resolve issues.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to build positive working relationships.
- AAT Level 3 qualification or equivalent experience, although candidates studying towards further qualifications will also be considered.

Further detailsWhat's Important

Alongside technical capability, the organisation is seeking someone who is:
- Friendly, approachable and customer-focused.
- Comfortable speaking with customers and stakeholders.
- Proactive and willing to take ownership of tasks.
- Curious, inquisitive and keen to improve processes.
- A collaborative team player who enjoys working in a close-knit environment.

Additional Information
- Permanent position.
- 28-35 hours per week with flexibility around working pattern.
- Office-based role in North Tyneside with occasional flexibility when required.
- Salary £25,587-£27,251.
- Opportunity to gain exposure to a finance system implementation project.
- Support available for ongoing professional development and finance qualifications.

For a confidential discussion or to apply, please contact Louise Smith at Nigel Wright Recruitment.
